headline: opus_plc is implemented: with --aug_opus_plc_p > 0 a codec call can take an in-process libopus 1.3.1 path (Gilbert-Elliott packet loss, decoder PLC, 48 kHz decode + resample_poly) instead of ffmpeg. Default 0.0 returns the B3 augmenter object, so the run is B2f. The in-process packets are byte-identical to the ones ffmpeg writes (21/21 runs), so only the receiver differs. `checks cpu` passes 117/117 in 269 s, and the manifest check shows 0 violations.

files.purpose: New. ctypes binding to libopus, loaded on first use only. draw_codec_params makes codecs_augm's draws in the same order; ffmpeg_opus runs codecs_augm's ffmpeg pipeline on pre-drawn values. Also check_ranges, ge_mask, loss_bin, the encoder (configured like ffmpeg 4.2 libopusenc) and a 48 kHz decoder that conceals lost packets with the NULL-payload PLC call. roundtrip_mask and opus_loss_roundtrip destroy encoder and decoder in finally. Selftest with named asserts loads / ctl_roundtrip / plc_not_zero / shape_finite.

Registers the opus_plc lever (codec slot; counters opus_plc, plc_l0_5 / plc_l5_10 / plc_l10p, fail_opus_plc; filter opus_plc, codec libopus; describe text; header with the libopus version). Adds RTCAugConfigB4 opus_plc_p / opus_loss / opus_burst. _init_opus_plc raises if the codec is off, profiles are random, or a range is out of bounds, then runs the selftest. _lever_opus_plc routes picked calls in-process (ffmpeg with the same draws on failure) and unpicked calls to codecs_augm.

Literal b4.add_argument calls for --aug_opus_plc_p (float 0.0), --aug_opus_loss (float nargs=2, 0.01 0.20) and --aug_opus_burst (float nargs=2, 1.0 4.0), with the plan's help text. validate_b4_args checks the ranges only when p > 0.

Adds _equiv_opus_plc (plan item 3, plus the levers-off / codec-on no-libopus probe), a codec_draw_order group, an opus_plc group (validation, header, selftest values, GE statistics, PLC only from the first lost packet, real lever with an rng4 replay, loss bins and the 0 0 control, fallback, three-lever chain, zero-loss attribution, packet parity with ffmpeg), _opus_call_timing inside timing, and a dsp_slices --lever opus_plc run plus attribution unit cases. CPU_GROUPS updated.

Report only: opus_plc_reading (falsifiers 1 and 2 with both readouts named, must-not-move guards per readout including matched qq / wechat bona recall from metrics.json breakdowns, ep1 TrainAcc) and --attribution_control MERGE FINAL for falsifier 3. JSON key opus_plc_reading.

Flag rows marked implemented; new section 'Lever opus_plc' (mechanism, rng4 draw order, ffmpeg 4.2 pre-skip note, fallback, selftest, counters, header, off behaviour, zero-loss result, cost, readout); check-table rows; libopus restart note.
opus_plc part: what exists, measurements, decisions and deviations, final results.
Probe: selftest, packet parity with ffmpeg's Ogg stream, aligned SNR, CPU-s per call.
The opus check block before it was spliced into checks.py.
Toy model driven through b4wave.train.main() in modes off / opus / ctrl / all3 (wiring check, not training).

levers.deviations: (1) Zero-loss attribution bar. It is applied per profile on energies pooled over the 3 clips. The plan says 'on every profile', and the v2 table it cites has one value per profile. Every clip x profile value is printed. Applied per clip, the check FAILS on one clip (offline/zh Train_038736): qq 14.78 dB and wechat 12.96 dB against the 15 dB floor. Pooled, the minimum margin is +1.22 dB (wechat), against v2's 2.0. (2) VBR constraint is explicitly set to 0, which is what ffmpeg's '-vbr on' does (libopus defaults to constrained VBR); the byte-identical packets confirm it. (3) Loss / burst ranges are validated in validate_b4_args only when p > 0 ('Read only when p > 0'); the augmenter init re-checks them. (4) Readout addition, not in the plan's section 3 CLI list: opus_plc_reading and --attribution_control. It is a report only and changes no verdict. (5) Checks added beyond the plan: packet parity with ffmpeg's Ogg stream, a draw-by-draw rng4 replay, PLC only from the first lost packet, GE statistics. (6) data.py is in the plan's file list but needed no change; core already wired the B4 factory.

equivalence_argument: With --aug_opus_plc_p 0.0 the lever is not in active_levers(args), so build_rtc_augmenter_b4 returns build_rtc_augmenter_b3(args). That is the B3 object itself: every codec call is utils.rtc_augment.codecs_augm with the same parent draws, there is no rng4, and describe(), meta_keys, the config fields and the header lines are unchanged. b4_config_from_args reads arg_fields only for active levers, and validate_b4_args checks the ranges only when p > 0, so the loss / burst flags are not read. b4wave.opus_plc is imported only inside _init_opus_plc and _opus_header, and the library loads only on the first _lib() call. A fresh-process probe with the levers off and the codec on finds neither b4wave.opus_plc nor libopus mapped. The model is untouched. When the lever is on, the parent stream still matches B2f: (a) draw_codec_params makes codecs_augm's draws in the same order (same end state on 1,000 start states and 14 real calls, same ffmpeg commands, bit-identical output); (b) at opus_plc_p=1.0 with the round trip replaced by ffmpeg on the pre-drawn profile, the outputs are bit-identical to B3; (c) with the real path the parent stage:* and codec:<app> counts equal B3's, and at p=0.3 every unpicked clip is bit-identical to B3. All B4 draws (pick, loss, burst, one random() per packet) come from rng4 = default_rng([seed, pid, 0xB4]), replayed exactly.
open_issues: Zero-loss attribution passes only per profile. With the bar applied per clip it fails on one clip (offline/zh Train_038736): qq 14.78 dB and wechat 12.96 dB against the 15 dB floor at integer alignment; sub-sample alignment raises wechat only to 14.18. Pooled over the 3 clips, the minimum margin is +1.22 dB (wechat), below v2's 2.0. The packets are byte-identical to ffmpeg's, so the residual is the plan's listed SILK-layer decoder / resampler difference (libopus vs ffmpeg's native decoder and swresample). The reviewer should confirm the per-profile reading.

ffmpeg 4.2 writes the Ogg pre-skip at the encoder rate (104) instead of 48 kHz (312). The ffmpeg path, i.e. all B2f codec audio, therefore decodes 66-71 samples (about 4.3 ms) late and finalize drops the clip's last ~69 samples. The in-process path trims 3 x look-ahead as the plan says and lines up with the input (lag -4..+1). So picked and unpicked clips differ by a constant ~69-sample offset. It applies to both classes equally, and the attribution control arm ('--aug_opus_plc_p 0.3 --aug_opus_loss 0 0') covers it. Kept as planned, documented in the README.

LOC is above the plan estimate of 280: opus_plc.py has 311 code lines (binding 84, round trip 142, selftest 85), plus about 55 in augment and 17 in train, so about 383 excluding checks and readout. The readout adds about 90 and the checks block about 450. Whether this meets max_loc_per_lever 400 depends on what the limit counts.
The readout gained opus_plc_reading and --attribution_control, which are not in the plan's section 3 CLI list. They are report only and change no verdict.

A container restart can wipe the system libopus together with ffmpeg. With the lever on, start-up then raises OSError (no silent pass-through). Optional hardening: conda-forge libopus in rtc-sdd, found through {sys.prefix}/lib/libopus.so.0.
GPU checks and smoke runs were not run here (CPU-only step). checks gpu covers opus_plc generically.
